LESSON: ORDERING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: PRE- NUMBER ACTIVITIES
Topic 1.3: Ordering
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Ordering, part of PRE- NUMBER ACTIVITIES in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we identify long objects? 2. Why do we order items?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Ordering together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: Teamwork-The Learner recognizes the importance of team work while sharing ideas,

working together and describing the sequence of arranging play items in order from biggest to smallest in groups.

Values:
• Responsibility: The Learner develops accountability as the learner handles play items appropriately and puts them back in their

rightful place after use.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

• Self- care: The Learner relates clothes to their use in daily life (sweater to keep one warm so that they don’t become sick)

Link to other activity areas:

• Creative Activities: The learners develop inventiveness while finding ways to match and pair clothes.
